name: Guangdong Greenway Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangdong Greenway Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, sale, and servicing of lithium-ion battery packs and lithium-ion cells in China, Europe, Hong Kong, Asia, North America, and internationally. The company's primary products include lithium-ion batteries for light vehicles, energy storage batteries, consumer electronics batteries, and lithium-ion batteries and ion cells, etc. It also engages in trading and investment activities. The company's products are used in electric bicycles, electric mopeds, electric motorcycles, electric scooters, laptops, drones, robots, AGVs, medical devices, portable energy storage, and residential energy storage.
